about_the_game:
HumanityEcho is a cyberpunk tactical RPG where your choices shape the city of the future.

In the game, you are part of a dirty war for freedom in a decaying coastal metropolis. Here, corporations play God: they decide your fate, and your life is nothing more than a resource to them.

However, the time has come to decide whether you will remain a puppet in the hands of monsters or dare to become a hero who will write a new story.

🔍 Key features:

Tactical turn-based combat — use cover, routes, and hacking tricks to survive against armed enemies.

Implants and modifications — upgrade your body and weapons, develop deadly prototypes right in underground workshops.

Deep story and non-linear plot — your decisions affect the fates of characters and the balance of power in the city.

Cyberpunk locations — ghettos, rebel hideouts, corporate factories, and underground catacombs that hold dark secrets.

Network of interactive events — situations that arise during the game force you to choose: spend resources, betray allies, or risk your life.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 — NVIDIA 470+ / RX 460 — Mesa 21.2+ / Intel Iris Xe — Mesa 21.2+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (NVIDIA 535+) / RX 580 (Mesa 23+), Vulkan 1.1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2015 or newer) / Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 2–compatible GPU, 2 GB VRAM (Intel Iris 2015+ or Apple GPU), MoltenVK/Vulkan
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M2 or newer) / Intel Core i5 (2019 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or Radeon Pro 2018+, 4 GB VRAM, Metal 2
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
